name: Puebla

queries.query: mapa catastral predial Puebla consulta predio parcelas catastro municipal oficial
queries.scope: Find Puebla-specific cadastral registry and public parcel map access.
queries.result: The Municipality of Puebla identifies a municipal Dirección de Catastro and documents cadastral registration/certificate and cartographic-plan workflows. The city GIS REST catalog lists layer 103, “PREDIOS CATASTRO USO DE SUELO”; its title suggests parcel/land-use content but does not establish that geometries are parcel boundaries. A read-only layer-schema request failed during TLS negotiation before HTTP response. A corrected bounded WUP-point query used explicit inSR=4326, outSR=4326, outFields=OBJECTID, and resultRecordCount=3; it failed at the same TLS step. No complete parcel polygon was received.
queries.executionMethod: Spanish-language search and municipal Catastro procedure review, followed by public REST metadata/layer inspection and a bounded point query at the WUP centroid.

queries.query: Puebla Mexico official municipal cadastral parcel registry GIS map query predio boundary
queries.scope: Verify English primary sources and inspect the city GIS layer response.
queries.result: The city Catastro procedures describe cadastral registration and cartographic plans. The municipal REST catalog exposes a named Predios Catastro Uso de Suelo layer, but it may contain land-use thematic objects rather than parcel polygons. The layer schema request and one bounded WUP-point feature query (explicit EPSG:4326 input/output, OBJECTID only, three-result cap) both failed before HTTP response because the direct host closed the TLS handshake. No full polygon or parcel attribute was obtained.
queries.executionMethod: English query with official municipal procedure and GIS REST follow-through; direct bounded query failed before a service result.

portals.name: Dirección de Catastro Municipal de Puebla
portals.operator: Tesorería Municipal, Ayuntamiento del Municipio de Puebla
portals.observation: Municipal information identifies the Catastro office and its technological multi-purpose cadastre platform. The 2024 procedure manual describes cadastral registration certificates, map composition and delivery, and GIS/cartography handling. This confirms a city-specific registry, not an anonymous feature endpoint.

portals.name: Puebla municipal GIS REST service
portals.observation: The public catalog names layer 103 “PREDIOS CATASTRO USO DE SUELO”. No feature response was obtained. Because it is a combined land-use theme, it is not treated as a verified cadastral parcel polygon layer.

requests.observation: Municipal Catastro page describes the office and its multi-purpose cadastre platform.
Municipal Catastro procedure manual, revision 2024. Procedures include cadastral registration certificates and cartographic plans.
Public REST catalog lists municipal layers including layer 103 PREDIOS CATASTRO USO DE SUELO.

Read-only layer metadata/schema request failed before HTTP response: LibreSSL reported SSL_ERROR_SYSCALL during TLS negotiation; the web fetch tool also marked the URL inaccessible. No object-ID field or geometry type could be inspected.

One bounded WUP-point query with explicit input/output WKID 4326, only OBJECTID requested, full geometry enabled, and a three-record cap failed before HTTP response: LibreSSL reported SSL_ERROR_SYSCALL during TLS negotiation. No result, geometry, or attributes were received.

freshResearch.supersededAttemptNote: An earlier point probe omitted the input CRS and requested all fields, but TLS negotiation failed before any response or attributes were obtained. It was superseded by the explicitly EPSG:4326, OBJECTID-only, three-result probe. No owner or contact values were received or retained.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: Puebla Municipality maintains a municipal Catastro and city georeferenced map; the REST catalog exposes a land-use theme referring to cadastral predios.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: The city registry and map workflow are confirmed. The target point query failed before returning features; the thematic layer is not accepted as a parcel-boundary layer without geometry metadata and a full feature response.

technicalBlocker: The municipal REST host closed the direct TLS handshake for the bounded feature query; the web fetch of the specific layer returned 502. No full feature response was available for inspection.
remainingUncertainty: Whether layer 103 carries complete parcel polygons or only land-use thematic units; whether the WUP point intersects a public full-polygon layer; current public access to the georeferenced map.
nextStep: Retry the city REST query from a normal browser path and inspect layer 103 metadata/geometry before treating it as a parcel source.
pointBasis: UN WUP 2025 population-weighted settlement centroid; this is not a municipal boundary or a parcel-coverage claim.
registryBasis: The 2024 Municipality of Puebla Catastro procedure manual documents municipal cadastral registration, parcel-linked GIS/cartography work, and composition/delivery of cadastral plans. This establishes a city-specific Catastro registry. Layer 103 remains an unverified land-use theme candidate because its schema and geometry response could not be fetched.
